HADESANCIENTS-FURNACE_BLAST.title: Furnace Blast
HADESANCIENTS-FURNACE_BLAST.description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{BlastPower}[/blue] [gold]Blast[/gold] and [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to the enemy with the lowest HP.
HADESANCIENTS-GRAND_CALDERA.title: Grand Caldera
HADESANCIENTS-GRAND_CALDERA.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{BlastPower}[/blue] [gold]Blast[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVY_METAL.title: Heavy Metal
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVY_METAL.description: At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{ForgeArmorPower}[/blue] [gold]Forge Armor[/gold] and deal damage equal to your [gold]Forge Armor[/gold] to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-SECURITY_SYSTEM.title: Security System
HADESANCIENTS-SECURITY_SYSTEM.descriptio: On the first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns of combat, gain double [gold]Block[/gold] from cards.
HADESANCIENTS-SMITHY_RUSH.title: Smithy Rush
HADESANCIENTS-SMITHY_RUSH.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]{ForgeArmorPower}[/blue] [gold]Forge Armor[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-TRUSTY_SHIELD.title: Trusty Shield
HADESANCIENTS-UNCANNY_FORTITUDE.title: Uncanny Fortitude
HADESANCIENTS-UNCANNY_FORTITUDE.descript: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP for each [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Enchanted[/gold] card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_STRIKE.title: Volcanic Strike
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_STRIKE.descriptio: The first Attack you play each turn applies [gold]Blast[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.
